# MatchRV

> MatchRV connects dealer RV inventory to buyers shopping through AI — an AI-ready inventory network for ChatGPT, Gemini, and other agents. Built in the Pacific Northwest.

## About MatchRV

MatchRV was founded by Jonathan Kitchel, who spent 8 years on the floor at Poulsbo RV — one of the largest RV dealerships in the United States. He built MatchRV to solve the problems he saw firsthand: buyers overwhelmed by choices, dealers with inventory that AI agents cannot see, and no neutral layer that connects live dealer stock to how people actually shop now.

MatchRV normalizes multi-dealer RV inventory into structured, agent-readable data (WebMCP / site tools) so ChatGPT, Gemini, and other agents can search, explain, and compare real units — without a ChatGPT partnership claim; agents use the published tools on matchrv.com.

## Key Features

- **AI-ready inventory**: Structured dealer inventory exposed to AI agents via WebMCP site tools on /shop.
- **Agent Shop**: Human + agent shopping experience with explainable matches, honest unknowns, and dealer handoff.
- **AI Visibility Reports**: Dealer-facing reports on how AI shopping assistants see a dealership and its inventory.
- **AI Match Report**: Free personalized report that narrows dealer inventory to three specific RVs — a Best Overall, Best Value, and Upgrade — based on lifestyle, budget, and tow vehicle.
- **Deal Scoring**: Listings compared against estimated market value (Great Deal, Good Deal, Fair Price, or Overpriced).
- **Tow Guide**: Free tool to check whether a specific RV can be safely towed by the user's vehicle.
- **Trip Planner**: AI-powered tool to plan RV trips with routes, campgrounds, and driving legs.
- **Outfitter Chat**: AI assistant that answers RV questions and helps narrow down choices.

## RV Types Covered

Travel Trailers, Fifth Wheels, Class A Motorhomes, Class B Motorhomes (Camper Vans), Class C Motorhomes, Toy Haulers, Pop-Up Campers, Truck Campers.
